notes: Two routes from ابن عيينة: via معمر, or via عمرو and يحيى بن سعيد; the text writes Zuhri, Hind and Umm Salama again for the second, so the groups are separate with a null tail
Umm Salama's own words carry the saying (rule 6), so she is the last link
The text's «وعمرو، ويحيى بن سعيد» sits after a complete route with no ح; read as a second route, not a settled ruling, which is why the reading is flagged here
